record.question: According to which article of the Indian Constitution, the Union Budget of a year is referred to as the Annual Financial Statement?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
Article 112(1) calls the President’s yearly statement of the Union government’s estimated receipts and expenditure the “annual financial statement.” The Constitution requires it to be laid before both Houses of Parliament. “Union Budget” is common usage for this statement and associated fiscal proposals; the constitutional term sought in the question is Article 112’s Annual Financial Statement.

Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/08/cb1b190ea633a1746368ed1fac35fb30.pdf
